popup.empty: Nothing copied. Type a request below, or copy something and press the hotkey again.
popup.placeholderClip: Or tell me what to do with this text…
err.acc.title: Pasting needs the Accessibility permission
err.acc.msg: macOS asks only once: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility. The text is already copied in the meantime.
err.nokey.title: No API key set
err.nokey.msg: Add your provider's key in Settings. It stays on your computer.
err.auth.title: Invalid or expired API key
err.auth.msg: The provider rejected the key (401). Check it in Settings › Account.
err.rate.title: Too many requests
err.rate.msg: Provider limit reached (429). Try again in {{n}} seconds.
err.offline.title: You're offline
err.offline.msg: No connection to the provider. Try again once you're back online.
err.toolong.title: Text too long
err.toolong.msg: {{msg}}. Copy a shorter part and try again.
err.other.title: Something went wrong
nav.label: SETTINGS
acc.title: Account & model
acc.lead: Hopper uses your API key, stored in a file only your user can read, or a model running on your computer. Claude Pro/Max and ChatGPT Plus subscriptions can't be linked from third-party apps; Claude Max includes monthly API credits.
acc.endpointHelp: Any server that exposes OpenAI's chat completions API. The key below is optional.
acc.keyNeverShown: The key is never shown: to change it, paste a new one.
acc.localHelp: No key: Hopper talks to {{name}} at {{url}}. Texts never leave your computer.
acc.loadModels: Load the list from the provider
hk.title: Shortcuts
hk.lead: The global hotkey opens the popup over any window and reads the clipboard at that moment. Click the field and press the combination you want.
hk.taken: {{sc}} isn't available: another app probably uses it already. Pick another one.
hk.active: {{sc}} is active. Press Save to keep it.
hk.help: At least one modifier (⌘, ⌃, ⌥ or ⇧) is required, or a function key. Some combinations are reserved by the system or other apps.
hk.actionsHelp: Each quick action can have its own combination: it opens the popup and runs the action on the copied text right away. Set them in Quick actions.
hk.inPopupHelp: 1–6 runs a quick action · ↵ sends or copies · ⌘↵ pastes into the app · Esc closes.
act.title: Quick actions
act.lead: The first {{n}} appear in the popup with keys 1–{{n}}. The others run only with their shortcut. Drag to reorder.
act.newPrompt:
Write here what to do with the text.

{{token}}
act.libHelp: Click to add it to your actions. Then edit it as you like.
act.name: Name
act.varHelp: Without a variable, the copied text is appended at the end.
act.pasteNow: Paste into the app right away
act.clipEmpty: The clipboard is empty: copy some text and try again.
act.noActions: No actions. Add one or open the library.
gen.title: General
gen.lead: Hopper lives in the menu bar. No server: texts, keys and history stay on your computer.
gen.autostartHelp: It waits for the hotkey with no windows open. You can quit it any time from the menu-bar icon.
gen.themeHelp: The popup is translucent and shows what's behind it. "System" follows the macOS or Windows appearance.
gen.languageHelp: The language of Hopper's interface. The language of the answers is chosen in Your assistant.
gen.accHelp: Only needed for "Paste into the app": Hopper presses ⌘V for you. Everything else works without it. Grant it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility.
gen.upToDate: You already have the latest version.
gen.updatesHelp: Hopper checks on its own at startup and tells you in the popup. Updates come from GitHub and are signed.
gen.historyHelp: The last 30 threads stay on this computer and reopen from "Continue in chat".
gen.dataHelp: Holds settings, history and keys (readable only by your user). Deleting it resets everything.
gen.aboutText: Hopper is open source under the MIT license. Made by Pasquale Capuano with Tauri, Rust and React.
prof.title: Your assistant
prof.lead: A few choices, nothing to write. Hopper turns them into the instructions that go with every request.
prof.name: Name
prof.whoHelp: Optional. They give context, for example who signs emails or what a text refers to.
prof.langHelp: "Same as the text" answers in English to an English email and in Italian to an Italian message.
len.normal.hint: as much as needed, no padding
prof.sigPh: Name to sign emails and messages with
prof.sigHelp: Used when an action writes a message for you, like "Reply". Empty: uses your name.
prof.extraPh: Optional. E.g.: I work at a fencing school, my colleagues are Mihail and Sarah, never use emoji.
ai.tooLong: Text too long for the model
ai.endpointMissing: Enter the endpoint URL in Settings
prov.anthropic.desc: Anthropic. Claude Max includes API credits.
prov.openai.desc: GPT, with a key from platform.openai.com.
prov.ollama.desc: Models on your computer. Free, offline, private.
prov.ollama.offline: Ollama isn't answering on localhost:11434. Start it, or install it from ollama.com and download a model with `ollama pull llama3.2`.
prov.lmstudio.desc: Local models through LM Studio's server.
prov.lmstudio.offline: LM Studio isn't answering on localhost:1234. Open LM Studio and start the local server (Developer › Start server).
prov.groq.desc: Very fast answers on open models.
prov.deepseek.desc: Cheap, good at code and reasoning.
prov.custom.name: Custom
prov.custom.offline: The endpoint isn't answering. Check the URL in Settings.
err.screen.title: Screenshots need the Screen Recording permission
err.screen.msg: macOS asks once: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording. Turn Hopper on there, then relaunch Hopper: the permission only applies after a restart.
err.novision.title: This model doesn't accept images
err.novision.msg: Pick a model with vision in Settings › Account (Claude, GPT, Gemini, or llava / qwen2.5-vl on Ollama).
hk.shotHelp: Opens the system's region picker (like ⌘⇧4). The popup then shows the capture with the actions that work on images.
gen.grab: Read the selected text at the hotkey
gen.grabHelp: Hopper presses ⌘C for you, reads the selection and puts your clipboard back as it was. No need to copy first. Needs Accessibility on macOS.
gen.screenHelp: Only needed for screenshots. Grant it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen Recording.
dict.title: Dictation
dict.lead: Hold a key, talk, let go: the text appears where your cursor is, in any app. Transcription needs a Groq or OpenAI key; the clean-up uses your chat model.
dict.hotkeyHelp: Works everywhere, like the main hotkey. Pick something you can hold comfortably.
dict.holdHint: press and hold, release to insert
dict.toggle: Press to start, press to stop
dict.groqHint: Whisper large v3 turbo · fast, free tier
dict.keyMissing: No {{name}} key yet: add it in Account & model.
dict.cleanupHelp: Punctuation and capitals, removes “uh” and false starts, understands “new line”, “new paragraph” and “scratch that”. Uses the chat model and its key.
dict.vocabularyHelp: Names, brands, jargon, separated by commas: helps the transcription spell them right.
dict.noAudio: No sound captured. Check the Microphone permission for Hopper in System Settings.
dict.noKey: No {{name}} key: add it in Settings › Account.
